'''Hante''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|15|Hante}}</ref> and a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="LAD" /> Operating out of [[Merich's Bend Tavern]] on [[Ifeoma]], Hante supplied weapons and supplies to Rebels operating throughout the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Hante was part of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Juri Marbra]]'s operation to smuggle five hundred [[Imperial Munitions/Legends|Imperial Munitions]] [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] to a beleaguered Rebel base, using [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Thaddeus Ross]] and his ship, ''[[Kierra]]''.<ref name="LAD" />
